fixed.summary: Cap cards at the built-in art size and reserve room for the fan and selected-card lift, keeping end cards and picked-up cards inside wide, phone and short hosts.
Omit the portrait body when no portrait is supplied and cap supplied portraits at the built-in art size so health and status effects stay visible in wide hosts.
The default preview fixture now supplies an active settings page and toggle, range, select and key-binding rows instead of showing only the header.
